system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:44 UTC, nora.blake created ext.rwong on the domain controller; the creation event and the following Freelancers group addition share the same subject logon ID.
The new account has the ext. naming pattern and was added to Freelancers, matching the stated help-desk practice. The available records do not show an administrator-group addition.

At 13:46 UTC, Cisco AnyConnect's VPN UI was launched under nora.blake's user context, and a Cisco-signed VPN DLL was loaded. This is notable given the stated absence of organizational VPN, but these records do not establish a VPN connection.

At 14:06 UTC, Chrome accessed drive.google.com through the proxy. The logged tunnel transferred 4,143 client bytes and 3,673 server bytes; this establishes a connection, not file upload or data exfiltration.

The proxy also recorded a Chrome connection to www.bing.com, and the workstation's Sysmon record shows Chrome connecting to the configured proxy. These records are consistent with ordinary browser use but do not establish the content accessed.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT tunnel metadata, not encrypted traffic contents, visited paths, or whether files were transferred; the Google Drive connection alone cannot establish upload activity. (T048-00014, T048-00015)
The supplied records show the AnyConnect UI launch and DLL load but no VPN connection or resulting remote session. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)

The supplied records show account creation and Freelancers membership, but do not provide a complete account-group membership history or later authentication and use of ext.rwong. (T048-00007, T048-00008)
claims_not_established: Whether creation of ext.rwong was authorized for a specific person or business request.
Whether ext.rwong received group memberships or privileges beyond the Freelancers addition shown in the supplied records.
Whether the AnyConnect UI was used to establish a VPN or other remote session.
Whether any data was uploaded to Google Drive or another unapproved service.
Whether ext.rwong was subsequently used to access systems or data.
additional_evidence_needed: Confirm the help-desk request, approval, intended user, and temporary-account expiry for ext.rwong.
Retrieve the account's complete group membership and privilege changes, plus subsequent authentication and activity.
Check endpoint and network telemetry for an AnyConnect connection, VPN tunnel, or remote session after the UI launch.
Review proxy, endpoint, and cloud-service audit telemetry for Google Drive requests, uploads, or file transfers around the alert window.
